description.en: Plays a full-screen movie as a child scene, with configurable fade timings for the screen and BGM around the movie.
Name/path of the movie to play.
Frame at which the fade begins.
Frame at which the fade ends.

Likely true once the child movie scene was created; null if the call was invalid (fewer than 4 arguments). The success value is produced by an internal scene-creation helper that wasn't fully traceable from the decompiled code.

example.code:
// Play a full-screen movie with fade timings
CMND_MAKE_CHILD_MOVIE_SCENE(_movie, snd, _scrA_fade, _scrB_fade, _bgm_fade, _frm_bgn_fade, _frm_end_fade);
